title: SREV-072 file recovery MUP path buffer contract

source_path.description: Incoming TruePath and redirector share suffix

fallback.description: Original TruePath comparison when local normalization allocation fails

contracts: wmemcpy requires valid source and destination buffers for the requested character count
path2 may receive the File_Mup prefix only after Dll_Alloc returns non-null
path2 may receive the redirector suffix only inside the same allocation-success gate
TruePath may be replaced by path2 only after both wide-copy operations initialize the buffer
Allocation failure must keep the original TruePath and skip only local redirector normalization
